Title: Appointment Kept (A Fog Harbor Mystery)
Author: Dani Wood
Hook: Tessa Hartwell came to Fog Harbor to shelve books. When the dentist circling her library turns up dead, his secrets, fake pills, and blackmail, are too serious to ignore. Now someone’s after her too.

Title: The Reluctant Coroner (Fenway Stevenson Mysteries #1)
Author: Paul Austin Ardoin
Hook: Blood is thicker than oil... until murder changes everything. Fenway Stevenson returns to the town where her estranged father is practically king. Will the coroner’s murder turn family bonds deadly?

Title: A Cut Above
Author: Rebekah Dodson
Hook: After finishing third on SuperChefs, Allison Chase teams with detective Lucas Gray to investigate when former castmates fall victim to deadly tragedies.

Title: The Girl Once Known
Author: R.M. Demeester
Hook: After a violent hit-and-run shatters Mira’s life, she must unravel the lies surrounding the attack and her troubled childhood before uncovering the truth costs her and those she loves everything.

Title: A Road More Travaled (Cumberlin Intelligence Agency #1)
Author: Rebekah Dodson
Hook: Diana Cumberlin flees her unpredictable husband and as a vengeful mob boss closes in she is determined to protect her daughter and confront her past.

Title: Meditation and Mischief (Magical Cozy Mystery Book Store #8)
Author: Elizabeth Pantley
Hook: A book club is whooshed into a mystery novel. It's set at a class reunion held on a tropical island. They must solve a ghost’s murder case to get out of the book.

Title: Michigan Fixer
Author: Phil Warner
Hook: Follow Kelly Ryan as his life evolves from the class clown to a fixer for those who can afford to owe him. Skyrocketing into the life of the rich and famous, he struggles with justice vs vengeance!

Title: The Disappearance of Emily: Destiny Falls Mystery & Magic Series #2
Author: Elizabeth Pantley
Hook: A journey through a magic mirror to an enchanted land. A mysterious family she never knew she had. A mystery to unravel and a murder to solve. Hayden and her sassy sidekick are up for the task.

Title: Girl in Trouble
Author: Stacy Claflin
Hook: Alex rarely gets to see the daughter he put up for adoption years ago. But when the girl disappears, Alex throws himself into the case… Can he find her before it’s too late?

Title: Honor Roll of Lies
Author: Darcie Morin
Hook: What happens when a guy blows his family life up and realizes maybe he’s not americas favorite dad after all?

Title: Wired Rogue: Paradise Crime Thrillers #2
Author: Toby Neal
Hook: Sophie Ang is a former FBI agent & hacker who likes kids & animals better than people. In a case of kidnapping by a cult on Hawaii island, Sophie must use all her skills to save lives--including her own.

Title: Hunted
Author: LaBrie James
Hook: She survived the attack that killed her best friend—but the nightmare isn’t over. A dark, gritty thriller of obsession, forbidden attraction, secrets, and a killer.

Title: Death in the Berwyns (Claire Tanner Series #1)
Author: JJ Sullivan
Hook: If the woman they thought was killed all those years ago is still alive, why has Jim Fitzgibbon spent 32 years in prison for her murder?

Title: The Christmas Present
Author: Lorna Dounaeva
Hook: Harassed by a teenage gang, a family flees to the Scottish Highlands for Christmas.

Title: The Final Sentence
Author: Nicole Annbury
Hook: A serial killer. An unsolved murder. A town full of secrets. When Margot returns to Cape Ivy, she may be closer to the killer than she realizes.

Title: The Signature Line
Author: Nicole Annbury
Hook: A feminist therapist. A serial killer. And an empire built on secrets. When their paths collide, someone will pay the ultimate price.

Title: The Paranormal Detectives Books 1-3
Author: Lily Luchesi
Hook: Vampires stalk the streets. Demons make deadly deals. And a half-vampire agent named Angelica Cross wants him to join the FBI's most classified division.

Title: The Wife I Was
Author: Maria Frankland
Hook: A collapsing marriage, a cousin who's getting too close and a daughter caught in the middle. Just when Georgia thinks things can't get any worse, the unthinkable happens.

Title: Low Water
Author: JJ Sullivan
Hook: A drowned man. A ruined detective. A city built on lies. When Hedley Robson starts digging, the truth leads straight to Newcastle’s most dangerous men

Title: Tinsel Tragedy (Holiday Hijinx Series #1)
Author: Clare Lockhart
Hook: She can spot a liar—but can she catch a killer? Juliet Marlow escapes to a charming northern resort as Santa's helper, until a dead body brings her past roaring back.

Title: Peril Among the Pansies
Author: Kristy T Dixon
Hook: A dead gravedigger. A suspicious grandfather. And the sheriff Neeley never quite got over.

Title: One Wonders (Silas McKay Suspense Series #1)
Author: Luana Ehrlich
Hook: When Silas allows a new female colleague to help him investigate an employee suspected of selling company secrets, he finds her as fascinating as the case itself, but then the situation turns deadly.

Title: Call it a Knight
Author: K Howell
Hook: Detective Eli Knight joins forces with an FBI team and a serial killer to solve his latest case. WHOLE SERIES FREE.

Title: Knight Shift
Author: K Howell
Hook: Agent Knight and his team investigate a series of murders in a gated community with a nosy HOA. WHOLE SERIES FREE.

Title: A Bridesmaid’s Guide to Murder : An Emelia Walsh Cozy Mystery (Emelia Walsh Sutton Cozy Mysteries Book 1)
Author: Abigail Scott
Hook: She’s paid to be your best friend on your big day. But when someone turns up dead, she starts asking questions—while the infuriating, hot detective would prefer she stay out of his investigation.

Title: The View from Nob Hill
Author: Ty Hutchinson
Hook: After two bottles of wine, a woman watches a man fall from a building. Then she learns her family and best friend lied about knowing him. Was it suicide—or murder?

Title: Lest We Forgive (Detective Liz Moorland #1)
Author: Phillipa Nefri Clark
Hook: A detective chasing a fugitive. An ex-cop haunted by the past. And a child who may have seen too much.

Title: Corktown (Abby Kane Thriller #1)
Author: Ty Hutchinson
Hook: They locked him up seven years ago. He’s still killing. Abby Kane must confront a serial killer who defies all logic.

Title: THE NINETEEN (a Jack Shepherd novel, #6)
Author: Jake Needham
Hook:
THERE WERE NINETEEN HIJACKERS
YOU KNOW ABOUT.

AND ONE YOU DON’T.

Title: How to Commit the Perfect Murder in Ten Easy Steps
Author: Jessica Huntley
Hook: Ever wondered what Clueless meets Gone Girl would be like? Now you don't have to! Meet Ashleigh Carmichael ... but she has more to her than meets the eye. Best get your notebook and pen out for this one!

Title: The Piper Sniper (A Travel Writer Cozy Mystery Book #1)
Author: Kelly Young
Hook: A retired reporter turned travel writer. A lakeside town's quaint tradition. A murder that shocks everyone. Can she solve the mystery before more pipers die?

Title: Run For The Hills (Flint River Series #1)
Author: Jodi Burnett
Hook: Fleeing a deadly stalker, Joscelyn finds refuge in a small Montana town. But when her past follows, the people she loves are in danger. Can she stop him before it’s too late?

Title: Extraction (US Marshal Thriller Series #1)
Author: Jodi Burnett
Hook: US Marshal Dirk Sterling hunts an international smuggler carrying a priceless stolen artifact. If he fails to recover it, its sale could fund a deadly global terrorist plot.

Title: Would You Rather
Author: Shannon Hollinger
Hook: A life-altering scandal turns into a chilling game of deception in this dark, twisty page-turner. Not recommended for readers who need trigger warnings.

Title: Deadly Sanctuary (Cassidy Knox series #1)
Author: Shannon Hollinger
Hook: Deep in the heart of the untamed Florida Everglades lies a web of secrets, danger, and deceit. Get ready to dive into a heart-pounding mystery where trust is a luxury and survival is a game of wits.

Title: Not Her Story Anymore
Author: Momo Marie
Hook: A South Florida reporter is in a coma. Her boyfriend is missing. The police suspect her older sister Elaine. Desperate for answers, she hires a PI to find out what really happened.

Title: Fireside and Secrets: A Cozy Mystery with Dragons
Author: K.E. O'Connor
Hook: Villagers are vanishing without a trace. Reluctant sleuth Bell and her mischievous wyvern Hodgepodge hunt for clues, uncovering banned magic, royal secrets, and a mystery that puts them in danger.

Title: It Began With a Lie (Secrets of Redemption #1)
Author: Michele Pariza Wacek
Hook: All Becca wanted was a fresh start. That wasn’t what she got. Get started with this award-winning series today.

Title: Out of the Ashes (Danger in Destiny #1)
Author: Melanie D. Snitker
Hook: Someone wants Megan Bristow dead, and she has no idea who. She and firefighter Bryce Keyes will have to put the past behind them and work together before her would-be killer strikes again.

Title: Ledge Pond
Author: Sangay Glass
Hook: Candice enters the Adirondack wilderness to end a deadly cycle. Armed with a strange plan, bizarre coping mechanisms, and wry snark, she thinks she knows what she’s walking into. She’s dead wrong.

Title: Sirens of the Siamese Ponds Wilderness
Author: S.G. Glass
Hook: Avi is falling for the mysterious girl at the water’s edge. But when Jess Taylor investigates a grisly death nearby, she begins to suspect Avi’s lonely girl may not be what he thinks she is.

Title: Pranks, Poitín, and Púcas (Skye O'Shea Paranormal Cozy Mystery Series #3)
Author: Rowan Dillon
Hook: Everyone’s getting excited for Samhain. Can this savvy ex-pat spot a harbinger of doom before destruction descends?

Title: A Murder of Crowes (The Crowes Trilogy #1)
Author: Michael Paul Patrick
Hook: A killer is targeting teachers. Forensic psychologist Eli Crowe recognizes the pattern: his mother was one of them. Catching her killer could cost him what remains of himself.

Title: Apartment 4C
Author: Michael Paul Patrick
Hook: Trauma taught Lena Ortiz to watch every window and question every sound. Across the courtyard, someone is learning her routine—and counting on everyone calling it paranoia.

Title: All the Right Favors
Author: Cassie Croft
Hook:
In Manhattan, everyone owes someone.

All Claire and Daniel Mercer wanted was to get their daughter into the right school. All it took was one small favor — because in Manhattan, nothing is ever free.

Title: Poison Point (Wild Blue Air Series #1)
Author: Sabine Frisch
Hook: A female bush pilot, a poisoned developer, and a town brimming with motives. As Elle Reid investigates, a fresh murder exposes an old secret—and danger takes flight over Echo Lake.

Title: Deadly Ruse
Author: Tina Saxon
Hook: Buried alive, I fought to survive. A K9 rescued me, but it was his handler who captured my heart. Someone wants me dead, and love might be the very thing blinding me to the truth.

Title: All Hallows' Eve in Stickleback Hollow (#3 The Mysteries of Stickleback Hollow)
Author: C.S. Woolley
Hook: A frightful affair with death in the air, will Lady Sarah's first All Hallows' Eve in Stickleback Hollow also be her last?

Title: I'll Never Let You Go (Samantha Raven Book #2)
Author: Bobbie Robins
Hook: The one who got away is the one Harley can’t forget. Now he’s out of prison, abducting women nationwide—and Samantha Raven is his ultimate target. Can police stop him before he finishes what he started?

Title: I'll Be Your Shadow
Author: Bobbie Robins
Hook: Samantha Raven thought she’d escaped her past. But someone is watching her, and two mysterious men have entered her life. One may protect her. The other may be the reason she’ll never feel safe again.

Title: Four Good Reasons (Kenna Devlin Mysteries #3)
Author: Kate Francis
Hook: PI Kenna Devlin investigates a missing person at a pharmaceutical company, only to find a dangerous connection to her own family. Can she stop a deadly medical plot from taking more lives?

Title: Death Beneath the Covers
Author: Fiona Tarr
Hook: High-class Madam Liz Jeffreys can't unsee her friend's lifeless body. Detective Jack Cunningham doesn’t want her interfering. When Liz discovers corruption, she becomes next on the hit list.

Title: Lawful Duty: A Devonshire Crime Thriller (The DC Spiller Mysteries #1)
Author: Michael Campling
Hook: A woman snatched from a dark street. The shadow of corruption. A race against time.

Title: A Study in Stone: A British Mystery (The Devonshire Mysteries #1)
Author: Michael Campling
Hook: Dan Corrigan wants to disappear, but life has other ideas.

Title: Appetizers and Alibis
Author: Erica J Whelton
Hook: Opening night success turns deadly when Chef Jessica's sous chef is murdered and revenge from her father's past comes calling. Murder was not on the menu.

Title: Judged
Author: Aime Austin
Hook: Casey Cort’s career didn’t go as planned. Now she’s fighting to keep a mother from losing her child to the system—and learning that doing the right thing can cost you everything.

Title: Rejection is Murder
Author: Carol E. Ayer
Hook: Mystery writer Cat Summers and her literary agent, Whitney Mowse, team up to investigate a cold case murder. But Cat knows more about the crime than she's ever let on.

Title: Buried Secrets (Ella Perri Mysteries #1)
Author: Krissy Baccaro
Hook: When Ella Perri uncovers a deadly family secret, she becomes the target of someone determined to silence her. To survive, she must uncover the truth before it’s too late.

Title: Through Her Gaze (Roxy Powers Standalone Series Book One
Author: KAREN BRADY
Hook: Roxy Powers sees what others can’t. When her visions reveal a baby in mortal danger, she must uncover a powerful company stealing children for their telepathic abilities, before Lily is next.

Title: The Case of the Christmas Angel (Jack and Frances 1930s mysteries, #6),
Author: Carmen Radtke
Hook: 1932. While Jack and Frances enjoy their honeymoon, Uncle Sal secures a part in a talking picture. But he discovers that there’s a real villain on set, secretly taking compromising photos and selling them.

Title: Unknown Caller Book One - The Orphan Trilogy
Author: Karen Brady
Hook: PI Polly Stevens finds missing people. Then eight hours of her own life disappear. As strange clues emerge, Polly must uncover a sinister conspiracy before she discovers she may be its target.

Title: Paw & Order (The Detective Whiskers Cozy Mystery Series)
Author: Chris Abernathy
Hook: It takes more than a badge on your collar to make a cat a detective. Detective Whiskers is out to prove -  to himself and the world - that he has what it takes, with the help of a K-9 officer and other friends.

Title: Trapping, Turkeys, & Thanksgiving (A Camper & Criminals Cozy Mystery Series Book 28)
Author: Tonya Kappes
Hook:
Mae West is serving for Thanksgiving fun to a local running group to race in Thanksgiving’s annual Turkey Trot.
She never figured murder would be on the menu.

Title: Sixty (Linda Radcliffe Chronicles #1)
Author: Yvette Walker
Hook: Journalist Linda Radcliffe meets the past she thought was dead. Mayfield Sherman—a name etched in horror—was her big story. Decades later, Linda returns to confront trauma and a second chance at love.

Title: The Last Owners (Crocus Hill Inn Mysteries)
Author: Jean Rezab
Hook: When Courtney learns the farmhouse she's turning into a  bed and breakfast once belonged to a couple who disappeared eight years ago, the project takes an unexpected twist.

Title: Clifford's War: Bluegrass Battleground
Author: J. Denison Reed
Hook: Private Investigator Clifford Dee took a job from the Mafia. He couldn't refuse his promotion, but didn't want it, and now must fight his way out of the gang.

Title: Imprinted
Author: Elizabeth Charles
Hook: A home invasion at Tess's 18th birthday party ends in the death of her boyfriend. Grieving and vulnerable, she’s easily seduced by her parents' college friend. She'll have to dig deep to escape his evil agenda.

Title: Plan X: A Shakespearean Thriller
Author: Lise McClendon
Hook: An international thriller for the lover of intrigue, secrets, and spies

Title: Game of Lies
Author: Spencer Guerrero
Hook: After an amnesiac woman wakes up in a house she doesn't recognize, a stranger claims that  she murdered someone...what follows next is a twisted game of lies.

Title: THE XMAS DAY BUTCHER
Author: Spencer Guerrero
Hook: During the span of the 24 days leading up to Christmas, Lenny Frost must follow a series of Christmas-related clues—a twisted, sinister game created by someone named the Xmas Day Butcher.

Title: Feline Protector (City Shifter Mysteries #1)
Author: Sapphire Wolf
Hook: A cougar shifter detective must clear her human nemesis of murdering a wolf alpha before the fragile peace between humans and shifters erupts into chaos—and the real killer strikes again.

Title: Dwayne Morrow: Welcome to the Morrowverse (Dwayne Morrow Mysteries #1 - #3)
Author: Darin Miller
Hook: Dwayne Morrow is no Jack Reacher. He’s just an everyday guy with an incredible knack for getting into trouble. It’s how he gets out that’s the fun part. Omnibus collects first three in series.

Title: Blood Orchids, Book 1 Paradise Crime Mysteries
Author: Toby Neal
Hook: Hawaii island is backdrop to policewoman Lei's persuit of a case that captures her heart, but a stalker is closer than she knows as threads from the past tangle in her future. "Unputdownable first in series!"

Title: Cold Hit (Shadowfast Heist Thriller #4)
Author: Cole Chase
Hook: What begins as a simple handoff turns into a war. A whistleblower double-crosses billionaires, who strike back. Con man Quinn Richards is caught in the crossfire. Can his trickery (and his heavy metal band) settle the fight?

Title: Murder by Moonlight (Felines of Fairytale Forest #1)
Author: K.L. Montgomery
Hook: When murder strikes a family amusement park, custodian Cat is one of the prime suspects. Can the feral cats who keep the park clean help her solve this roller coaster of a case?

Title: Joyce AI
Author: Sabine Frisch
Hook: The world's most sophisticated AI will make your life a breeze. She knows everything about you. But someone wants the data inside the machine, and they will stop at nothing to get it. Not even murder.

Title: Murder Calls at Shadow Falls (Olivia Twist Series #1)
Author: Irene Jorgensen
Hook: When Olivia Twist poses as a psychic to avoid a catastrophe, it ends in murder and a friend’s arrest. Olivia continues the mystical masquerade to clear her pal’s name while hiding her own secret.

Title: Turnover My Dead Body (A Newfound Lake Cozy Mystery)
Author: Virginia K. Bennett
Hook: Are you looking for a Halloween costume party cozy mystery set around Newfound Lake in New Hampshire? The local librarian and her husband are trying to figure out WHODUNIT!? (Standalone Novella)

Title: Here Goes Muffin (The Mysteries of Cozy Cove)
Author: Virginia K. Bennett
Hook: The summer doesn’t peak in Maine until the week of the best renaissance faire in all of New England. What could possibly go wrong when an actor makes his final curtain call, and it's not voluntary?!(Standalone)

Title: The Murder at Graduation (Clara Young Mystery Book 9)
Author: Renee Marski
Hook: Graduation day is here. And the Valedictorian ends up murdered. Unable to help herself, Clara volunteers to help solve the murder, pulling her friends into the case.

Title: Hell as Well
Author: Becca Lynne
Hook: Evalynn escaped her parents' abuse, only to find herself trapped in another nightmare. When faith becomes a weapon and those sworn to protect her fail, how far must Evalynn go to save herself and her brother?

Title: Beach Club Bloodshed (Barefoot Sleuth Cozy Mystery #1)
Author: Christine Wellert
Hook: I'm a lifeguard, not a detective. But when a shark-tooth club shows up on a body, I guess I'm diving in--otherwise my best friend's going to be wearing orange for the next 10-20 years.

Title: Sugar: Black Ops: Sweet Spy Games (The Sugar Directive #3)
Author: Arla Jones
Hook: Former assassin Sugar became a vigilante hunting those the system protects. When a covert mission exposes ISRI, a shadow organization beyond government control, she’s pulled into black ops.

Title: Desert Viper: A Stiller–Sawyer Story (The Lost Tomb series Book 11)
Author: Arla Jones
Hook: Arizona, 1970. NASA pilot Cameron Sawyer discovers an ancient Door buried in the Sonoran Desert—and draws the attention of La Víbora, a deadly operative determined to open it.

Title: Inside The Mushroom Farm
Author: Athena Wynyard
Hook: Detective Bree Willard must determine if the criminal she’s chasing is mentally ill, or really as his victims claim him to be—a vampire.

Title: In His Sights (Second Sight #1)
Author: K.C. Wells
Hook: A serial killer is targeting Boston’s gay community with cryptic clues. A skeptical detective and a secretive psychic must work together before the killer makes his next move—and Dan becomes the next target.

Title: Nightwatch (Sentry 6 series #1)
Author: Nellie K. Neves
Hook: When he falls into her life, she only has two options: Trust a stranger or die. But things are never as they seem. If she loses her heart, she might lose her life too.

Title: Take Her Under
Author: Pamela Crane
Hook: Funeral home owner Ashley finds a corpse that looks identical to her on the embalming table clutching a mysterious note. As an undertaker she buries secrets with the dead, but someone is about to exhume hers.

Title: Beds, Breakfasts, & Beta Blockers (Three Dog Mysteries #1)
Author: Jann Franklin
Hook: She can't boil an egg, but she just might crack a case. When murder hits a dog-friendly B&B, Ro and her tail-wagging team sniff out the killer.

Title: Boudin and Bloodshed (Small Town Girl Mysteries #2)
Author: Jann Franklin
Hook: Remy Robichaux is missing...or is he? Ev Delafose and her exasperating PI untangle small-town Louisiana secrets, gossip, and tall tales.

Title: A Hare's Breadth from Death (The Thistle and Hare Mysteries #1)
Author: Maya Black
Hook: She inherited a bookshop, a cottage, and a rabbit who keeps finding bodies. A paranormal cozy set in a charming Cotswolds village.

Title: Bindings, Crimes & a Chihuahua (Paw-liday Craft Caper)
Author: Maya Black
Hook: Priceless books vanish before Christmas, and bookbinder Celia and her clever Chihuahua, Taco, must sniff out the culprit before the Heritage Festival.

Title: Yes, Pychological Thriller.
Author: Isabel Wells
Hook: Devil's News is landing the dream job you've always wanted, only to discover your coworkers are dying one by one.  As secrets surface and danger closes in, one question remains: who will be next?

Title: Out With the Sunset (Parks Pat Mysteries #1)
Author: P.D. Workman
Hook: Det Margie Patenaude is new to Calgary, but she does not have time to ease in slowly. A killer is loose, the park pathways no longer feel safe, and Margie has to prove she belongs on the case.

Title: An Abrupt Departure (A Bleeding Hearts Valley Thriller)
Author: P.D. Workman
Hook: When Graham Hall steps into an abandoned apartment, he expects to take out the trash—literally. But what he uncovers is anything but garbage. What he finds sends chills down his spine.

Title: Lethal Dissection (Dr. Zora Smyth Thriller Series #1)
Author: Dobi Cross
Hook: A murder suspect for the dead body on her dissection table, spunky surgeon-to-be Zora Smyth races to find the truth. Then more bodies drop…

Title: All the Bad Girls
Author: Kim Cresswell
Hook: They’ve been murdered, their bodies bound to wooden crosses and left floating in a lake. They aren’t the only ones...

Title: Reckoning (A Jordan Reynolds Thriller #1)
Author: Sable Noire
Hook: U.S. Marshal Jordan Reynolds poses as a cartel target's wife to keep her alive. When she uncovers a conspiracy of missing kids, she’ll break every rule for justice.

Title: Run for the Roses (Circles #1)
Author: Elizabeth Noble
Hook:
A killer romance!

When Val’s best friend is seriously injured, it's not long before her estranged father shows up at his front door and Val’s life takes a hard sideways turn.

Title: Scintilla (El Corazon #1)
Author: Elizabeth Noble
Hook: How far is too far to go to save someone you love? Brandon wields electricity. Raul is the werewolf determined to protect him. Their morals are tested when they go head-to-head with human traffickers.

Title: Desolation Gulch
Author: Jessica Jesinghaus
Hook: Valerie thought she’d found the perfect man, but when his facade breaks she must flee. But how do you escape a killer who can find you with the power of his mind?

Title: Litter Stalker Prey
Author: E Elizabeth Franklin
Hook: On a darkly humourous Friday the 13th, while a litter cleanup manager chases down her missing convicts, she catches a stalker and stumbles into a kidnapping!

Title: Murder By Thread (Willow Creek Series #1)
Author: Lainey Hollis
Hook: A quilt judge is dead, and everyone has a grievance. Join retired librarian Evelyn and her cat Sherlock to unravel small-town secrets in this cozy word search mystery.

Title: Over My Dead Husband's Body (The Ghosts of Landover Mysteries #1)
Author: Etta Faire
Hook: She was thrilled to inherit her ex’s Victorian, until she opened the door and his ghost was there, asking her to solve his murder. A paranormal cozy with heart, humor, and a lot of souls.

Title: Striker's Stand Straight Flight (Team Colt #0.5)
Author: Arleigh Jacobs
Hook: Honor is more than duty—it’s a choice.

Title: Squashed in the Pumpkin
Author: Jemima Jenkins
Hook: Betrayed, overlooked, and newly single, ex-librarian Maggie Moore trades beige cardigans for heels. Accused of murder after finding a body, the town’s new stranger must unmask the real killer.

Title: The Campsite Murder (A Quayside Adventure #2)
Author: Jemima Jenkins
Hook: Elisa expected luxury retreat-instead she got tents, no phones, and a strangled billionaire. Armed with chalk and 80 suspects, this middle-aged designer must catch a killer who just wrote her name on the wall.

Title: Dare You? (The Society Book 0)
Author: Karen Guyler
Hook: You instructed the assassins but you didn't obey the contract. Now they're after you.

Title: Haunted in Dearing (The Medium and The Ghost Hunter Book 1)
Author: Dennis Shock
Hook:
Cozy enough to curl up with. Eerie enough to keep the lights on.

Sage smoke hangs in the air. Tarot cards spread across a kitchen table in the dark. A Maglite clicks on in an empty hallway.

Title: Murder on Liberty Bay (Pacific Northwest Cozy Culinary Series book 1)
Author: Dennis Shock
Hook: What if you packed up your whole life to honor your late husband's dream, arrived in a gorgeous little seaside town at dawn, unlocked your new restaurant, and found a stranger dead behind the bar?

Title: Rule #1: Spies Don't Fall In Love
Author: Natalie Tay
Hook: I was only five years old when my Dad disappeared and the CIA barged into our home to tell us he was a Russian spy. Now, he’s back. And I can’t help but wonder what kind of damage he’ll do this time.

Title: The Protector
Author: Jason Caldwell
Hook: The Protector, Book One: Three generations of Corrigans protect their own. A 1969 cop. A writer gone rogue. A woman hunting an assassin. No superpowers, just skill, grit and family.

Title: Murder, 9 Points
Author: J Caldwell
Hook: The world's richest Scrabble tournament has a killer in the bag. Professor Charlene Montgomery goes undercover to spell out the truth before she's the next one off the board.

Title: Cody (Reed Hawthorne Security)
Author: Danielle Pays
Hook: Lucy's ex-husband drags her into a criminal scheme, putting her directly in the crosshairs. Former Navy SEAL Cody is determined to protect her, even if it means facing the past they never resolved.

Title: Cold Woods
Author: S. L. Hansen
Hook: FBI Agent Kenzie Harper is on the trail of a serial killer in Glacier National Park. Too bad she's afraid of the woods.

Title: Who She Was (Sylvia Wilcox Series #1)
Author: Braylee Parkinson
Hook: A secret can be buried, but it is never truly dead. P.I. Sylvia Wilcox investigates a cold case murder of a woman with a hidden past.

Title: Murder On Main Street (Cottage Country Cozy Mysteries #1)
Author: Anne Shillolo
Hook: Who killed the mayor? Newspaper owner Ginger Flynn is in the wrong place at the wrong time, and scores the number one spot on the suspect list.

Title: Born for Revenge (Paxton & Walsh Mysteries #1)
Author: Staci Troilo
Hook: The return of a traumatized missing teenager heats up a cold case. Detectives Walsh and Paxton uncover dark horrors in a desperate race to stop a predator before the past repeats itself.

Title: The Hackpen Hound (Narrowboat Rue Mystery #1)
Author: Tamsin Culpepper
Hook: Former nurse Nell seeks a quiet life on her narrowboat. But when a murdered villager is found with her herbal remedy, she becomes the prime suspect. Now, she must catch the real killer.

Title: Don't Close Your Eyes - Book one of the Hallowed Halls series.
Author: Mary Alford
Hook: They were a match made in the hallowed halls of Quantico. Until Death came knocking...

Title: Night Comes Down (The C.T. Ferguson Mysteries #13)
Author: Tom Fowler
Hook: When his home city of Baltimore falls victim to a ransomware attack, PI C.T. Ferguson goes undercover with the hackers.

Title: Trigger Point
Author: Darcie Morin
Hook: A series of catastrophic failures plunge New York City into chaos,Detective Zoe Grant is called to what appears to be an impossible murder, one that makes no sense.

Title: Cold Press (Anna Burgin British Mystery Thriller Series Book 1)
Author: David Bradwell
Hook: Packed with intrigue, Cold Press is a hugely entertaining British thriller. An investigative journalist vanishes on the cusp of unveiling her biggest ever story, and very soon the search turns deadly.

Title: This Side of Dark
Author: Caren Hahn
Hook: Christmas has a dark side in this holiday psychological thriller readers are calling A BRILLIANT DARK THRILLER, PHENOMENAL, and A ROLLERCOASTER OF EMOTIONS THAT WILL LEAVE YOU BREATHLESS.
